what_differs: On 08-18 the client set the player statuses to pending, active, inactive and banned (no 'Flagged for Fraud'). A person sets Banned manually, with no automation based on player status. On 09-23 the fraud banner was dropped, because the ban banner covers it. WAGR-1 still asks whether fraud should set a 'Flagged for Fraud' player status, is in Requirements as Must Have, and other tickets cite it as an open blocker.
suggested_action: Close WAGR-1 (and fix the WAGR-410 reference). Cite the 08-18 decision (four statuses, manual ban) and the 09-22/09-23 banner outcome. If ops still needs a rule for when a player is banned for fraud, open a new, narrower ticket.
